answer.rationale: Broadly deploy signup and onboarding simplification for self-serve SMBs. It has confirmed durable gains in completion, time-to-value, activation, and 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not counter the competitor with promotional pricing: prior targeted discounting lifted acquisition but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, creating unacceptable downstream value risk. This will not directly eliminate price-driven churn, but it is the strongest evidenced sustainable response available today.
